heroSummary: The 2026–27 school year begins on Monday, August 3, 2026. The last day of school is Tuesday, May 25, 2027, with a half-day schedule. Fall Break runs October 12–16, Thanksgiving Recess runs November 23–27, Winter Break runs December 21–January 1, and Spring Break runs March 22–26. DVUSD also schedules 90-minute early releases on selected Fridays and separate half-day schedules for conferences and semester-end dates.

Exact dismissal times vary by campus.

calendarFaqs.q: Are DVUSD early-release Fridays the same as half days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. On selected Fridays, schools dismiss students 90 minutes early. Half-day schedules are listed separately for conferences, semester-end dates, and the last day of school.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I find exact DVUSD dismissal times?
calendarFaqs.a: Check your school’s bell schedule for exact dismissal times. The district instructional calendar identifies early-release and half-day dates, but each campus sets its actual dismissal time.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the 2026–27 instructional calendar list graduation dates?
calendarFaqs.a: Graduation dates were still listed as TBD in the April 16, 2026 instructional calendar. Families of graduating seniors should check their high school’s announcements and the DVUSD calendar page for updates.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and does not automatically reflect later DVUSD revisions.

customSections.label: What Changed from 2025–26
customSections.content: DVUSD still has 180 student contact days, but several key dates shift in 2026–27. The biggest planning change is Fall Break, which moves about two weeks later than it did in 2025–26.
